_meta.description: Transcript for the Showcase voice sample phrase, for fixture and harness runs that upload a WAV sample to /v1/audio/transcriptions. Scoped to its own X-AIMock-Context (voice-sample-wav) so it never answers an ordinary transcription request: without that header an upload gets AIMock's no-match error (503 with --strict, 404 otherwise), never this transcript. Showcase voice routes only send audio to AIMock when OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_BASE_URL points at it explicitly. AIMock 1.37.4 matches transcription requests on endpoint, model and context only and never reads the uploaded file part, so this fixture cannot tell a real WAV from other bytes, an empty file or a missing file. Pinned by showcase/scripts/__tests__/aimock-voice-transcription.test.ts.

fixtures._comment: Requires all three: endpoint=transcription, model=whisper-1 (the @copilotkit/voice TranscriptionServiceOpenAI default) and X-AIMock-Context: voice-sample-wav.

transcription.text: What is the weather in Tokyo?
